operations.authorization: matching plan digest, named approver, explicit archive grant
operations.expected_state: source file ID, Docs revision ID, parents, locator fingerprint
operations.writes: idempotent canonical-Sheet upsert followed by readback
operations.source_mutation: archive move only; delete is unsupported
operations.rollback: restore the prior Sheet record (or remove a newly inserted row) and restore original parents
operations.verification: Sheet readback, preserved file ID/revision, exact archive parent, clean rescan
